title: intake.ocr-request.v1
description: Bounded OCR re-run request from an authenticated consumer. One request = one variant. The body carries identifiers and a closed parameter set only: no image bytes, paths, URLs, prompts, provider commands or secrets. Body limit: 16 KiB (enforced by the intake API, see rules_ocr_request).

request_id.description: Consumer-generated UUID; idempotency key. Same request_id + same canonical body replays the stored decision; same request_id + different body is request_conflict.

logical_id.description: Stable id of the image/page already handed over in a raw package. Quota key: 2 supplementary jobs per logical_id inside the 168 h image lifetime.

preset.description: Closed parameter of the variant. crop_bottom requires one of bottom_quarter|bottom_third|bottom_42pct; rotate accepts "auto" (provider enable_rotate) or null; full_res requires null or absent. Enforced by the if/then/else below.

note.description: Free text for the operator journal; scanned by the request_forbidden_field rule (no data URIs, image URLs/paths, base64 blobs).

observed_revision.description: Raw revision of logical_id the consumer analyzed before asking. Lower than the producer's current_revision -> stale_revision.
